needs: commands.test set to "npm test" in .factory/sandbox/manifest.json, and the now-untrue capabilities.not_exercised entry "Automated tests and total coverage" removed
why: The repo now has a test runner and 48 passing tests, but commands.test is still null and the manifest is protected, so the builder could not wire it up. I confirmed the consequence by running the gates directly: `bsf gates tests` reports `tests_source=no_tests` ("This repo has no test command, so there was nothing to run") even though `npm test` passes 48/48 and exits 0. `bsf gates coverage` reads coverage/lcov.info and reports total 98% only because I had run `npm test` by hand first; nothing in the pipeline generates that file, so in a clean run the coverage gate has no report to read. I verified the suite directly instead of through the gates: run, determinism, per-file isolation, exit-code propagation and 16 mutations of src/, all caught. Setting commands.test to "npm test" makes both gates see this suite.
